front.title: The AUREON Database-over-HTTP Protocol and Method Suite

abstract.t: This document specifies AUREON, a high-performance database-over-HTTP protocol. AUREON leverages HTTP's extensible method mechanism (RFC 9110) to introduce domain-aware custom tokens for relational database operations, Data Definition Language (DDL) governance, Data Control Language (DCL) permissions, and procedural Data Action Language (DAL) workflows. Furthermore, this document defines the complete IANA registration templates for the AUREON method suite and media type parameters.
